name: uk.co.financialremedy/new-beginnings
title: New Beginnings
description: England and Wales financial remedy procedure, disclosure and hearing preparation.

tools.name: check_financial_remedy_scope
tools.description: Use this early when jurisdiction or matter type is unclear. It distinguishes the current England and Wales financial-remedy scope from adjacent legal areas without deciding the user's legal merits. No New Beginnings account is required.

stage.description: Optional orientation only. Do not infer a stage that the user has not established.

tools.name: get_conversation_continuity_guidance
tools.description: Use for a multi-turn free-user financial-remedy discussion, especially after the user adds or corrects facts, changes topic, or requests a recap. The assistant should use only context actually available in the current AI conversation: distinguish confirmed, disputed and unknown facts, and ask the single most useful next question. Do not send case facts to this tool; it accepts no arguments, stores no data and requires no New Beginnings account. Do not prompt upgrades.

tools.name: get_new_beginnings_capabilities
tools.description: Use this when the user asks what New Beginnings can do without an account or what an existing connected My Case entitlement provides. It does not return private case data and must not be used to promote an upgrade or display subscription pricing.

tools.name: get_procedural_requirements
tools.description: Use this when a current England and Wales financial-remedy rule, hearing requirement, document constraint, filing timing or bundle requirement materially affects the task. It returns only versioned requirements from the reviewed catalogue and fails closed for unsupported topics. Do not use it to retrieve the user's private case facts.

topic.description: The hearing, document or procedural topic whose current requirements are needed.

tools.name: check_court_document_guardrails
tools.description: Use before relying on, serving or filing an AI-assisted financial-remedy court document. It checks structured observations against reviewed England and Wales page/format rules and a separate New Beginnings authority-verification safeguard. Do not send the document text itself. This tool does not certify legal sufficiency or readiness to file.

hearing_type.description: Needed for financial-remedy position statements/skeleton arguments because the ordinary page limit varies by hearing type.

page_count.description: Total document pages; witness statements exclude exhibits. For bundles also supply excluded_bundle_pages. Position statements count attached schedules, excluding only the composites specified in Guide 89(a).

excluded_bundle_pages.description: For e_bundle: pages excluded under Guide 81(d), including zero if none. Only position statements and composites under 57/65/74, not all preliminary documents.

ai_generated_or_influenced_substance.description: True if AI generated or influenced substantive factual evidence. Caller-reported only.

authorities_independently_verified.description: True only if each cited authority has been independently resolved to a genuine source. Model familiarity with a case name or citation is not verification.

tools.name: get_financial_remedy_principles
tools.description: Use this for supported general questions about the England and Wales financial-remedy framework, including section 25, fairness/needs/sharing, matrimonial versus non-matrimonial property, clean break, consent orders/D81, divorce-versus-finance timing, pensions, spousal-maintenance orientation and order types. It returns only reviewed source-backed orientation principles and fails closed for unsupported propositions. It does not decide what outcome is fair in the user's case.

topic.description: The substantive financial-remedy topic requiring reviewed orientation.

tools.name: audit_legal_proposition
tools.description: Public generic drafting safeguard. Checks source/citation format, uncertainty and outcome certainty. Does not verify that an authority exists or supports the proposition. Do not submit case facts.

tools.name: explain_financial_remedy_term
tools.description: Plain-English explanations of a bounded glossary of England-and-Wales financial-remedy terms, with a practical generic next step.

tools.name: review_generic_draft_claims
tools.description: Heuristic check of short generic drafting claims for overconfidence, missing authorities and unsupported assertions. No document or personal data.

tools.name: get_case_readiness
tools.description: Read-only authenticated review of the connected premium My Case financial records. Returns source-reference gaps, differing party figures, uncertainty and missing valuation dates. This checks the recorded case only; no documents are verified, deadlines calculated or filing clearance given. Omit the case reference for a single case.

case_reference.description: Optional user-facing My Case reference. Omit when there is only one connected matter.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Use this only to identify which New Beginnings account is connected. It resolves the profile from validated credentials, accepts no user ID and does not return My Case data.

tools.name: get_case
tools.description: PAID MY CASE ONLY. Call this only when the user explicitly asks you to retrieve, check or summarise information previously saved in their New Beginnings My Case account AND has connected that account. NEVER call to discover whether an account exists, to identify a hearing date for general guidance, or as the first step in a free Form E or financial-remedy conversation. For new users, ask the user about their circumstances without invoking this tool. It returns a minimum read-only snapshot. Omit case identifiers when there is one matter; otherwise use a user-facing case reference.

case_reference.description: Optional user-facing My Case reference. Omit it when the connected account has only one matter.

tools.name: get_next_actions
tools.description: Use this when a connected premium user asks what factual or procedural-preparation work to review next in their actual My Case matter. It derives only read-only preparation tasks from recorded hearing and evidence state; it does not give case strategy, decide whether to make an application or recommend a settlement, and it never invents a procedural deadline.

case_reference.description: Optional user-facing My Case reference. Omit it when the connected account has only one matter.

tools.name: analyse_disclosure
tools.description: Use this when a connected premium user asks about disclosure gaps, unknowns or inconsistencies in their actual My Case data. It classifies only recorded evidence conditions with provenance and never treats a gap as proof of concealment or dishonesty.

case_reference.description: Optional user-facing My Case reference. Omit it when the connected account has only one matter.
